question: 1 ​horsepower equals:
solution:
The correct answer is __**746 W**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1 horsepower** is equivalent to **746 watts (W)**.
 
• Horsepower is a unit of power that was originally defined to compare the output of steam engines with the power of draft horses.
 
• The unit was later expanded to include the output power of other types of engines and motors.
 
• 1 horsepower (hp) is equal to 746 watts (W), which is a measure of the rate at which work is done or energy is transferred.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **James Watt** is credited with defining the concept of horsepower to quantify the power output of steam engines.
 
• The term "horsepower" was adopted in the late 18th century during the industrial revolution.
 
• There are different types of horsepower, such as mechanical horsepower, metric horsepower, and electrical horsepower, but the most commonly used is mechanical horsepower.
 
• 1 mechanical horsepower is approximately equal to 745.7 watts.
 
• The use of horsepower as a unit of measurement has been largely replaced by the watt in scientific and engineering contexts.
